reasons.requirements: All seven acceptance criteria are covered, including UTC overdue logic, 400 on invalid dates, and removal via null; the spec only covered the filter (AC4, AC7) through a later update, but the diff delivers it.
reasons.scope: Only due-date and overdue-filter changes are present, with no unrelated edits.
reasons.tests: API tests are good (valid and invalid dates, update and clear, overdue filter including done and no-date cases), but no automated test covers the UI marker, due-date display or checkbox, and the one existing test was only updated for the new field.
reasons.conventions: Uses ValidationError mapped to 400, adds data-testid to every new element, stays dependency-free, and follows the TDD test style.
reasons.architecture: Server-side validation and isOverdue live in the store, but the page re-implements isOverdue in the browser and filters client-side rather than using the new ?overdue=true endpoint, which duplicates logic.
reasons.codeQuality: Date validation is correct with a round-trip calendar check and the code is readable; minor issues are reassigning the dueDate parameter and tests that compute dates from Date.now.
